verdict.rationale: Mercury says its AI reads bills and fills in their details so you can 'approve and pay in seconds' [mercury-docs-3]. Its payment docs describe approval controls on vendor payouts [mercury-docs-53], payment requests that require approval under organization approval policies [mercury-docs-55], and gated disbursements held for manual sign-off in the dashboard before funds release [mercury-docs-47, mercury-docs-38]. Together these cover the core bill-to-approval-to-payment flow, though the bill-upload side rests on one marketing line. missing for 10: detailed documentation of bill upload/ingestion mechanics, documentation of multi-step or role-based approval routing configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration of the bill-pay approval workflow
